# Format properties: Cards

> **Applies to:** Creators · Developers

Every card and property the Format pane offers for the visuals on this page (Card, Card (legacy), Multi-row card), generated from the visual definitions in the code. For how to use the Format pane, see [Format a visual](../../create-reports/format-a-visual.md); for what these visuals do, see [the visual article](../../visuals/cards.md).

The cards on the **General** tab that every visual shares (title, effects, header icons, tooltips, alt text) are listed once in [General tab](general-tab.md).

| Visual | PBIR type | Visual-tab cards | Properties |
|---|---|---|---|
| Card | `cardVisual` | 26 | 221 |
| Card (legacy) | `card` | 3 | 18 |
| Multi-row card | `multiRowCard` | 4 | 20 |
